source_instruction: i'm looking for a men's red button down casual shirt that is a large slim fit.
query: My roommate’s been obsessing over his new sourdough starter all week, he keeps ranting about how the kitchen humidity is messing with his rise and he burned three loaves last night trying to adjust the oven temp. He even made me taste a rock-hard discard cracker that tasted like salty cardboard and tried to say it was “artisanal.” I’ve heard slim fit cuts hang way nicer without bunching up under a cardigan for weekend brunch, that the red colorway pops really well with dark-wash jeans, that a size large fits guys with a 42-inch chest perfectly, and that anything priced under $30 doesn’t feel like a total waste if you spill coffee on it during the commute.
